record.resolution_criteria: Quarantine every composite chunk and invalid Pr locus; re-ingest each exact book/work span from pinned OGL with stable CTS/work identity; separate legacy and exact manifests; rewire citations/edges claim by claim; verify all 534 boundaries, sequence uniqueness, text hashes, no orphan citations, work-child identity, independent and adversarial reviews.
record.summary: An exhaustive audit of 534 legacy Sextus chunks found twelve cross-book/cross-work concatenations, one embedded internal heading and six invalid pseudo-CTS Pr loci. In particular passage_sext_420 joins AM XI.254-257 to AM I.1-4 while its parent/canonical identity points to PH; passage_sext_137 joins PH III.279-281 to AM VII.1-3. The manifest also conflates a mixed legacy snapshot with exact AM IX-X ingestion.

exit_criteria: Every one of the 41 substantive span divergences has an edition-specific adjudication or verified re-ingestion result.
Alexander De Fato 12 and 20 are re-collated and every direct versus reconstructed premise is explicitly typed and sourced.
Aristotle EN III.5 1113b7-8 and 1114b1-12 have distinct verified corpus passages, locators, translations and semantically revalidated citation sets.
Ps.-Plutarch exact Greek/English manifestations, section-to-Stephanus map, runtime non-citability policy and pseudepigraphic authority pass independent and adversarial review.
Calcidius 142-146 text, page map, identity and cautious author classification pass independent review; broader fate-excursus debt remains registered.
Carter's bibliographic identity is adjudicated; all claim-level locators distinguish author-manuscript pages from published pages, and no unmapped published-page claim is exposed as verified.
All resolved factual issues receive two independent reviews and an adversarial pass.

Irenaeus III.20/IV.37 false twins are quarantined and replaced by witness-specific Latin, Armenian, transmitted Greek fragment and reviewed translation manifestations with ten dependencies re-adjudicated.

Origen Exhortatio, Philocalia, De principiis and Romans manifestations have correct work identity, language, ancient/modern translator, indirect-witness role and exact snapshots; false tlg028/tlg012/pseudo-CTS paths are non-citable.
All Sextus PH/AM cross-book and cross-work concatenations, embedded headings and pseudo-Pr loci are split against pinned OGL and every citation/work edge is revalidated.
